FIELDS.NAME: SecureHome Alarm Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At SecureHome Alarm Solutions, we specialize in the installation, maintenance, and monitoring of state-of-the-art alarm systems for residential and commercial properties. Our operations encompass a comprehensive approach, including site assessments to determine the most effective security solutions tailored to our clients' unique needs. Our trained technicians are equipped to handle all aspects of alarm system deployment, and we maintain detailed documentation of each installation and subsequent maintenance activities. We prioritize safety by conducting regular training sessions for our staff and performing periodic risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities. Furthermore, we offer ongoing 24/7 monitoring services and adhere to strict certification processes, providing peace of mind for all our clients.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 04/15/2023; Cause: Equipment failure during installation; Amount: $1,200.00; Status: Resolved and replaced with new equipment.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM; Closed on Sunday.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B Safe, Grade 1, UL Listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: 24-hour security patrols and perimeter fencing installed around the facility.
